records.question: Miss Walter has 50 gold stickers. She also has twice as many silver stickers as gold stickers, and 20 fewer bronze stickers than silver stickers.  She wants to give the same number of stickers to each of her 5 students. How many stickers will each student receive?
records.response:
Miss Walter has 2*50 = 100 silver stickers.
She has 100-20 = 80 bronze stickers.
All together, she has 50+100+80 = 230 stickers.
She wants to give each student 230/5 = 46 stickers.
#### 46

records.question: Kendra wants enough shirts that she only has to do laundry once every two weeks. She wears one shirt to school for each of the five weekdays. Three days a week, she changes into a different shirt for an after-school club. On Saturday, she wears one shirt all day. On Sunday, she wears a different shirt to church than she does for the rest of the day. How many shirts does she need to be able to only do laundry once every two weeks?
records.response:
Kendra wears 5 shirts for school, 3 shirts for the after-school club, 1 shirt for Saturday, and 2 shirts for Sunday. She will need 5+3+1+2 = 11 shirts to wear each week.
To only do laundry once every two weeks, Kendra needs 11 * 2 = 22 shirts.
#### 22
